**Finding: deviation (medium)** — Article on Record Keeping and Reports, ¶ (b) (p0073), with cost allocation at p0064.

- **What's already fine:** independent CPA/Audit Professional selected by mutual agreement; scope limited to accounting records (no system access asserted); written request with a 30-day window; Licensor bears cost unless discrepancy exceeds 5% (preferred cost trigger).
- **Why it deviates:** no frequency limit at all, so audits could be demanded repeatedly. That fails both the preferred (once per 12 months) and fallback (once per year) positions on a material term.
- **Redline (validated, preferred level):** adds a once-per-twelve-months cap, business-hours timing, express exclusion of access to our systems/networks, and an auditor confidentiality undertaking — leaving the acceptable notice and cost terms untouched.
